label: Week 6
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-12T01:04Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Monday of Week 5 MNF (BUF at LAR live during pull), stamped vibe week reg-6. Volume landed for all 32 clubs. Loudest rooms: BAL, BUF, SF, ATL, CHI, DET, SEA, LAR, GB, NE. IND and TB fully quiet (their pools returned only other clubs, college, or other sports); NE and NYJ pools were mostly NBA/Knicks/F1/uniform noise, so their kept items come from other clubs' pools where they were participants. Dropped mostly college football (Red River fallout, Texas A&M/Elko, AP poll, BYU-Notre Dame, Ohio State-Indiana, Alabama-Tennessee, Jeremiah Smith draft talk), MLB/NBA/NHL/F1/Formula E, Cleveland Guardians name debate, Pat Patriot uniform debate, GTA VI stadium ads, parlay/fantasy/tier-list posts, Herbert girlfriend and trade fan edits, Guardian Cap and Glenn memes, Charlie Kirk memorial post, Gregg Bell layoff farewell, and heavy cross-club near-dupes.

items.title: LaFleur keeps staff, Beck activation on the table
items.one_line: After the 45-21 loss to Detroit, LaFleur ruled out staff or play-calling changes (DC Nick Rallis stays) and said the team will discuss activating rookie QB Carson Beck from emergency status for the Rams game.

items.title: Fans push Bidwill to sell amid discrimination suit
items.one_line: A franchise-record ninth straight home loss has fans campaigning against owner Michael Bidwill as a racial-discrimination suit from two ex-employees heads to NFL arbitration.

items.title: Brissett's 2-15 mark fuels Beck calls
items.one_line: Brissett threw for 292 and three TDs, mostly late, and fans want the rookie as Arizona sits 1-4.

items.title: Penix rib injury not serious
items.one_line: Schefter reported Monday that Michael Penix Jr.'s rib injury isn't serious and he could return Sunday against the Bears if he practices well.

items.title: Ravens rally past Falcons 30-23 in OT
items.one_line: Atlanta blew a 23-15 late lead; Tua Tagovailoa came in for Penix and threw the walk-off pick to Kyle Hamilton.

items.title: Minter upbeat on Lamar's ankle
items.one_line: Jackson (left ankle) is doing better and pushing to return, but it's unclear if he practices Wednesday before Sunday's Browns game.

items.title: Huntley leads 30-23 OT win in Atlanta
items.one_line: With Jackson out, Tyler Huntley tied it late and scored the OT sneak; Derrick Henry ran for 102 and Kyle Hamilton picked off Tua to end it.

items.title: Bills thin at WR for MNF
items.one_line: Joshua Palmer, DJ Moore (AC joint, ending a 92-game streak) and Ed Oliver are out; rookie Skyler Bell debuts and Trent Sherfield was elevated.

items.title: Bills at Rams on Monday Night Football
items.one_line: Allen vs. Stafford at SoFi, the last two MVPs, with bettors piling into the primetime matchup.

items.title: Knox drop costs an early TD
items.one_line: Dawson Knox couldn't hold an Allen throw at the Rams 23, and Buffalo settled for a field goal.

items.title: Moton and Wharton practice windows open
items.one_line: Carolina opened 21-day windows for RT Taylor Moton (blood clots) and DL Tershawn Wharton (neck surgery); WR Jalen Coker is on track for the Eagles game.

items.title: Bryce Young on the Manningcast
items.one_line: Young, leading the NFL at 317 passing yards per game with nine TDs and two picks, credited his teammates during the MNF broadcast.

items.title: Caleb Williams nearing return
items.one_line: Out since Week 2 with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, Williams shows strong signs of returning for the Falcons game; Ben Johnson will pick the starter off practice.

items.title: Bears routed 31-7 at Lambeau
items.one_line: Tyson Bagent threw two picks and was benched for Case Keenum as Chicago turned it over five times.

items.title: Packers LB says Burden 'quit'
items.one_line: Luther Burden III talked tough before the game, then had four catches for 47 yards, and Green Bay fired back postgame.

items.title: Bengals claim Jack Kiser, Bozeman to IR
items.one_line: Cincinnati claimed LB Jack Kiser from Jacksonville and put Swayze Bozeman on IR with a broken forearm; TE Tanner Hudson (pectoral) is being monitored.

items.title: Burrow's four TDs beat Miami 31-24
items.one_line: Cincinnati goes into its bye at 3-2 after Chase's 45-yard one-handed score.

items.title: Schwesinger and Judkins day-to-day
items.one_line: LB Carson Schwesinger and RB Quinshon Judkins have Grade 1 ankle sprains; nobody is ruled out for the Ravens, and Dylan Sampson may return from IR.

items.title: Browns sign Audric Estime
items.one_line: Cleveland signed RB Audric Estime off the Vikings practice squad to the 53.

items.title: Concepcion in concussion protocol after Fitzpatrick hit
items.one_line: Rookie WR KC Concepcion left the Jets loss after a flagged Minkah Fitzpatrick hit, and the league will review the play.

items.title: Cowboys hire Mike Pettine
items.one_line: Dallas added Pettine as senior defensive assistant to support first-year DC Christian Parker after a 2-3 start and a 31st-ranked defense.

items.title: Defense holds players-only meeting
items.one_line: Dead last against the run with zero interceptions, the defense met after the 24-16 home loss to Tampa Bay.

items.title: Cowboys open -1.5 at Green Bay
items.one_line: X chatter has Dallas a 1.5-point road favorite for the Week 6 Sunday night game, total about 50.5.

items.title: Surtain and Hufanga miss practice before TNF
items.one_line: On Seattle's report for the Thursday game, Denver had CB Patrick Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga out with ankle issues.

items.title: Payton takes back play-calling
items.one_line: Sean Payton reclaimed play-calling from Davis Webb before the Chargers win, but Denver still managed just 224 yards.

items.title: Bo Nix under the microscope
items.one_line: Nix went 16-of-27 for 123 yards in the 23-17 win, and analysts are split on his tape through a 3-2 start.

items.title: Lions crush Cardinals 45-21
items.one_line: Detroit scored on seven straight drives; Goff threw three TDs with no turnovers and Gibbs ran for 151 and two scores.

items.title: Campbell dedicates win to late announcer's wife
items.one_line: Dan Campbell gave the game ball to the wife of a late announcer after the rout in Glendale.

items.title: Hargrave tears Achilles in Bears rout
items.one_line: Love threw for 367 and two TDs in the 31-7 win, but Javon Hargrave's torn Achilles leaves the defense banged up.

items.title: Parsons won't practice this week
items.one_line: Micah Parsons (torn ACL) has no setbacks, but Green Bay won't bring him back to practice before Sunday night against Dallas.

items.title: Packers open as 1.5-point home dogs to Dallas
items.one_line: The Week 6 Sunday night line opened Cowboys -1.5, total about 50.5.

items.title: Stroud leads 26-3 win over Tennessee
items.one_line: Stroud went 26-of-34 for 261 with a passing and rushing TD as Houston's defense held the Titans to 187 yards.

items.title: Jaguars stun Eagles 19-17 in London
items.one_line: Cam Little hit a 57-yard field goal at the gun to move Jacksonville to 4-1.

items.title: Jaguars add snapper Jacob Bobenmoyer
items.one_line: Ross Matiscik (shoulder) won't go on IR; Bobenmoyer joins the practice squad in London ahead of the Texans game.

items.title: Chiefs bring back Justin Watson; Thornton to IR
items.one_line: Kansas City signed Watson to the practice squad as Tyquan Thornton goes on IR with a dislocated ankle; LB Cam Jones joins the active roster before the Chargers game.

items.title: Raiders sign Jamari Thrash to practice squad
items.one_line: Las Vegas added WR Jamari Thrash and moved Tyler Scott to practice squad/injured.

items.title: Burford under fire after Patriots loss
items.one_line: LG Spencer Burford leads NFL left guards with 23 pressures allowed, and fans want Caleb Rogers in.

items.title: Maye torches Raiders for five TDs
items.one_line: New England put up 536 yards on Las Vegas in the blowout.

items.title: Chargers injury list grows
items.one_line: McConkey (foot) dressed but didn't play; Tre' Harris is week-to-week (hamstring), Quentin Johnston is limited (chest) and Joe Alt is seeing a neck specialist.

items.title: Omarion Hampton falls to RB3
items.one_line: Hampton's snaps dropped to 20 and 25 the last two weeks as Vidal and Mitchell took more work.

items.title: Chargers 0-5 after 23-17 loss to Denver
items.one_line: Worst start since 2003 after a fourth-quarter collapse with a failed fourth down, a fumble and a Herbert pick.

items.title: Rams get Donald, Parkinson, Watson back for MNF
items.one_line: Aaron Donald, Colby Parkinson and Jaylen Watson were set to play against Buffalo; S Quentin Lake was questionable.

items.title: Adams beats Gardner-Johnson for a TD
items.one_line: Stafford hit Davante Adams on a fade to tie it 6-6 early in the second quarter.

items.title: Special teams give up 70-yard return
items.one_line: Ray Davis's opening kickoff return set up Buffalo's first points, renewing heat on the Rams' coverage unit.

items.title: Dolphins fall to Bengals 31-24
items.one_line: Miami stays winless as Jordan Battle picked off two passes and Burrow threw four TDs.

items.title: Vikings work out JuJu Smith-Schuster
items.one_line: At 5-0 heading into the bye, Minnesota looked at JuJu as Jauan Jennings has two catches in five games.

items.title: Vikings 5-0 after 23-13 win in New Orleans
items.one_line: Kyler Murray went 24-of-30 for 229 and a TD, and Aaron Jones ran for 113.

items.title: Flores defense keeps blitzing
items.one_line: Minnesota pressured on 45% of dropbacks and leads the NFL in sacks and points allowed per drive.

items.title: Maye's five-TD day routs Raiders
items.one_line: Drake Maye went 26-of-34 for 374 and five total scores with no turnovers as New England moved to 3-2.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson still not practicing
items.one_line: Moore said the No. 8 pick (hamstring) is progressing, with a debut eyed after the Week 8 bye.

items.title: Fans turn on Kellen Moore after Vikings loss
items.one_line: New Orleans managed 142 yards and Tyler Shough threw two picks; Moore took the blame.

items.title: Drew Brees enters Saints Ring of Honor
items.one_line: Brees became the ninth member at halftime of Sunday's game.

items.title: Giants and Commanders tie 27-27
items.one_line: Jameis Winston threw for 326 and three TDs to rally from 14 down; New York is 3-1-1 atop the NFC East.

items.title: Giants crack Bucky Brooks' top 10
items.one_line: FOX's Bucky Brooks put the Giants at No. 10 in his Week 5 rankings.

items.title: Jets snap skid, beat Browns 17-12
items.one_line: No. 2 pick Bailey had three of the Jets' eight sacks.

items.title: Fitzpatrick hit on Concepcion under league review
items.one_line: Minkah Fitzpatrick's flagged first-quarter hit on Cleveland's rookie WR splits fans; both coaches called it bang-bang.

items.title: Sirianni hopeful on Barkley and Smith
items.one_line: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith (hamstrings) might play Sunday vs. Carolina pending practice; Landon Dickerson could also return.

items.title: Shipley joins Bigsby on IR
items.one_line: Will Shipley has a partial plantar fascia tear, leaving Dameon Pierce and Carson Steele in the backfield.

items.title: Sirianni takes blame for London loss
items.one_line: His decision not to take a touchback set up the return and the 57-yard walk-off; Philly is 2-3 on a three-game skid.

items.title: Roman Wilson out a couple weeks; Roberts signed
items.one_line: Wilson (finger) joins Pittman (IR) and Skowronek as outs for the Bucs game; LB Elandon Roberts joins the practice squad with Payton Wilson and Patrick Queen missing.

items.title: Jaylen Warren named featured back
items.one_line: McCarthy said Warren, with 490 yards in three games filling in for Rico Dowdle, is the 'featured player right now.'

items.title: Rodgers throws three TDs again in Colts win
items.one_line: Rodgers went 22-of-31 for 235, three TDs and a rushing score in the 34-22 win.

items.title: Charbonnet not expected to debut; JSN limited
items.one_line: Zach Charbonnet (knee) stays limited and JSN (ankle) is limited but expected to play Thursday vs. Denver; LBs Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt sat out.

items.title: Fans push Drew Lock over Darnold
items.one_line: Darnold threw two picks in the 32-29 loss to San Francisco.

items.title: 49ers edge Seahawks 32-29
items.one_line: A seven-turnover NFC West game went San Francisco's way on a late field goal.

items.title: Deebo Samuel out a couple weeks
items.one_line: Samuel strained a hamstring; Pearsall is out for the season, Stribling 10+ weeks, while Bosa, Juszczyk and Thompson could return for MNF.

items.title: Purdy now the MVP betting favorite
items.one_line: At +250 ahead of Josh Allen, with 13 TDs, two picks and a 119.3 rating through five games.

items.title: 49ers rally to 5-0 in Seattle
items.one_line: Purdy found Brandin Cooks for the go-ahead score and Eddy Pineiro iced it from 43.

items.title: Titans 0-5 after 26-3 home loss
items.one_line: Cam Ward went 23-of-36 for 170 with a pick and four sacks as Tennessee managed 187 yards.

items.title: Commanders let the clock run out in OT tie
items.one_line: Washington had the ball at the Giants 24 in overtime and let time expire; Jayden Daniels, back from injury, ran for 103 and two TDs and took the blame.
